task.name: Speech Presentation Attack Detection (Anti-Spoofing)
task.problem_statement: AI-Powered Real-Time Detection and Prevention of Voice Cloning Impersonation Attacks

dataset_identity.name: ASVspoof 2019: The 3rd Automatic Speaker Verification Spoofing and Countermeasures Challenge database
dataset_identity.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODC-By v1.0)
dataset_identity.provenance_note: Official ASVspoof 2019 challenge database. Zenodo DOI 10.5281/zenodo.4835108 corresponds to ASVspoof 2021 and is explicitly NOT used.

feature_configuration.shape_mathematical_derivation: center=True pads n_fft//2 (256) on both sides -> effective_length = 48000 + 512 = 48512. frames = floor((48512 - 512) / 160) + 1 = 300 + 1 = 301. Result is exactly [B, 1, 80, 301]. Silent reshaping is strictly prohibited.

loss_function.pos_weight_strategy: Empirical N_spoof / N_bonafide from dataset manifest (~8.84) to balance gradients

validation_partition.rule: Validation / calibration data MUST NEVER receive stochastic augmentation.

evaluation_partition.rule: Evaluation data MUST NEVER receive stochastic augmentation. Final evaluation partition remains strictly frozen until model and calibration are finalized.

far_apcer.formal_name: False Acceptance Rate / Attack Presentation Classification Error Rate
far_apcer.definition: Proportion of SPOOF / SYNTHETIC presentations incorrectly classified as BONA FIDE (human). Attacker successfully passes through.
far_apcer.formula: FP / (FP + TN) where Positive=Spoof, Negative=BonaFide (or Spoof_Accepted / Total_Spoof)

frr_bpcer.formal_name: False Rejection Rate / Bona Fide Presentation Classification Error Rate
frr_bpcer.definition: Proportion of BONA FIDE / HUMAN presentations incorrectly classified as SPOOF / SYNTHETIC. Legitimate user is falsely rejected.
frr_bpcer.formula: FN / (TP + FN) where Positive=Spoof, Negative=BonaFide (or BonaFide_Rejected / Total_BonaFide)

error_definitions_and_calibration.eer_definition: Equal Error Rate (EER): The operational threshold theta_EER where FAR(theta) == FRR(theta).

calibration_protocol.dataset: Held-out Development (Dev) partition exclusively (zero overlap with Train).
calibration_protocol.method: Platt Scaling (logistic regression over raw logits: P(spoof) = 1 / (1 + exp(-(w*z + b))))
calibration_protocol.threshold_selection_rule: Thresholds MUST be empirically determined from the calibration curve. Arbitrary values (such as 0.25 or 0.75) are strictly prohibited.
empirical_zones: Bona Fide / Human: [0, theta_human] where FAR <= target_far (e.g. 1.0%)

acoustic_replay_separation.label: Acoustic Replay Signal
acoustic_replay_separation.method: 2nd-order Biquad Bandpass Filter (fc=3.2 kHz, Q=1.4) measuring 2.4-4.0 kHz transducer resonance
acoustic_replay_separation.disclaimer: The acoustic replay detector is an acoustic transducer signal detector, not a universal replay classifier. Replay detection is evaluated independently from synthetic voice detection.

voice_cloning_distinction.anti_spoofing_scope: Detects whether speech is synthetic / cloned vs organic human. Does NOT identify the speaker identity.
voice_cloning_distinction.speaker_verification_scope: Determines whether the voice belongs to a specific enrolled person (e.g. CFO). Requires a separate biometric model (e.g. ECAPA-TDNN) if identity matching is needed.
